title: Map configuration, version 1
description: The configuration of one map. The converters make the settings of each renderer from it. See README.md in this directory.

version.description: The version of the schema. The embed page uses it to select the schema file.

description.description: A short text about the map, as plain text.

locale.description: The language of the texts that the configuration does not give. The default is da-DK.

view.description: The start view. Without it, the map shows all the features.

center.description: The centre of the map: longitude and latitude, in this order, as in GeoJSON.

zoom.description: The zoom level at the start.

zoomGate.description: Hides the features when the user zooms out, for data sets with many features.

minZoom.description: Below this zoom level, the map does not show the features.

sidebar.description: The settings of the sidebar. Without it, the sidebar is on the left with the list, and has no search.

position.description: The side of the map with the sidebar. The default is left.

list.description: If true, the sidebar shows a list of the features. The default is true.

categories.description: If true, the user can turn each layer on and off. The default is false.

search.description: The search fields of the sidebar.

local.description: If true, the user can search in the features of the map. The default is false.

address.description: If true, the user can search for an address with Adressevælger. The default is false.

layers.description: The data sets on the map. Each layer has its own data set, filter and fields.

filters.description: The open filters: filters that the user can change.

report.description: A link for each feature, for example to a form that corrects the data.

url.description: The address of the link. It must start with https://. {id} and {seeAlso} get the values of the entity.

target.description: _blank opens a new window. _top opens the link in place of the page around the frame. postMessage sends {type: "enter-map:report", id, seeAlso} to the page around the frame. The default is _blank.

leaflet.description: Settings that only the Leaflet renderer uses. The other settings are for all renderers.

baseMap.description: The name of the base map, from a list on the server. Not a URL. Without it, the renderer uses its default.

septima.description: Settings that only the Septima renderer uses. The other settings are for all renderers. Do not put a configuration in the format of Septima here.

baseMap.description: The name of the base map, from a list on the server. Not a URL. Without it, the renderer uses its default.

text.description: A text that the map shows, as plain text. HTML is not permitted.

name.description: A short name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

zoom.description: A zoom level. 0 shows the world. 18 shows a street.

path.description: A dot path into the properties of a GeoJSON feature, for example address.streetAddress.

values.description: Maps a code in the data to the text that the map shows, for example {"yes": "Ja"}.

field.description: A value from the properties of a feature, with the text that the map shows for it.

path.description: Where the feature keeps the value.

fallback.description: The text if the feature has no value. Without it, the map does not show the field.

format.description: The type of the value. The default is text.

values.description: The text for each code. A code that is not here is shown as it is.

layer.description: One data set from Enter on the map.

id.description: A short name of the layer, unique in the map. Filters refer to it.

dataSet.description: The id of the data set in /sources.json of Enter. The same data set can be in two layers, with a different where.

colour.description: The colour of the markers, as #rrggbb.

icon.description: The name of the icon in the markers.

where.description: The closed filter: an NGSI-LD query that the entities must also match, for example isAccessibleForFree==true. The user cannot change it.

row.description: The fields that identify a feature, for example in a list.

detail.description: The fields of the detail view, in this order.

filter.description: An open filter that the user can change. It changes only the features of the layers in appliesTo.

type.description: toggle: the user turns one code on or off. select: the user selects one code. multiselect: the user selects one or more codes.

values.description: The codes of the filter, with a text for each.

appliesTo.description: The layers of the filter. Each layer can keep the value in a different attribute and with different codes.

filterTarget.description: Where a layer keeps the value of a filter.

path.description: Where the features of this layer keep the value.

codes.description: The value in the data for each code of the filter, for example {"free": true}. Without it, the value in the data is the code.
